#
# The checks required on `main`, and how each one is run.
#
# Left of `=` is the status-check context, exactly as the ruleset names it.
# Right of `=` is the recipe the job runs. The workflow contains no copy of the
# command, so local and CI cannot diverge.
#
# Adding a check means adding it in three places: the ruleset, a workflow job,
# and here.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Confirm what is actually enforced, rather than trusting this comment:
#
#   gh api repos/hey-vera/radar/rules/branches/main --jq '[.[].type]'
#
# Expected, and true on 2026-08-25:
#
#   ["deletion", "non_fast_forward", "pull_request", "required_status_checks"]
#
# An empty array means nothing is enforced and every line below is decorative.
# That was the state until 2026-08-25, while an earlier version of this file
# opened "The required status checks on the `main` ruleset" and named seven --
# the file describing the enforcement was the only evidence the enforcement
# existed. LEARNINGS entry 13.
#
# This file has now been wrong in both directions in one day, which is the
# argument for writing the query instead of the answer rather than for writing
# a more careful answer.
#
# Verified in the failing direction too, because a check confirmed only where it
# passes is not confirmed: a direct push to `main` is refused with "Changes must
# be made through a pull request" and "8 of 8 required status checks are
# expected".
#
# There are no bypass actors, admins included. An override means editing the
# ruleset, which is a deliberate act and leaves a trace -- the point, given how
# this file read yesterday.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

build           = just build
tests           = just tests
lint            = just lint
fmt             = just fmt
licence-headers = just licence-headers
cargo-deny      = just cargo-deny
msrv            = github-only: pinned toolchain, no local recipe (the host may not have 1.90 for its triple)
mutants         = just mutants
